title: Foundations in Early Childhood Education
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement, Foundations in Early Childhood Education
outcomes: Integrate understanding of the needs, characteristics, and multiple influences on the development of children birth to age eight as related to high quality care and education.
Design, implement, and evaluate environments and activities that support positive, developmental play and learning outcomes for all young children.
Apply effective guidance and interaction strategies that support all children’s social learning, identity and self-confidence.
Develop strategies that promote partnerships between programs, teachers, families and their communities.
Demonstrate ethical standards and professional behaviors that deepen understanding, knowledge and commitment to the EC/CD profession.
careers: teacher in a Title 22 preschool or children’s center

blocks.name: 1. Choose one of the following courses

notes: Codes are printed without a space (e.g., ECE101); they correspond to closed-list ECE 101, ECE 110, ECE 112, ECE 114, ECE 115.
Block 1 says 'Choose one of the following courses' and 'Complete the following number of credits: 3'; recorded as choose_units with minimum 3 (equivalent to choosing one 3-unit course).

The description refers to the award inconsistently as the 'Early Childhood Education Core Certificate' and 'Early Childhood Education Certificate' as well as the Foundations certificate; it also mentions 44 units for the next-level Certificate of Achievement in Early Childhood Education, which is not this award's total.
The 'Associate Teacher level of the Child Development Permit' is mentioned as a permit eligibility, not recorded as a career.
